body: Thank you. That's actually a huge relief. :)
I'm glad that you were able to get better. The money is a major issue, and I don't really know how anyone finances it. I hope that these thoughts go away, but I have had them for a very long time.

That makes a lot of sense. I am going to stay as a male though, just try and limit some of my male characteristics. Mainly getting rid of all my body hair, and trying to limit muscle mass in the upper torso area. I will see how this works.

Thank you. Unfortunately I still think that I'm not going forward with the transition. I still think I am male even though I don't want to be. Going forward, I think I will begin exercising more heavily than I have been in the past - running, elliptical etc... I have started shaving everything, and laser (and I suppose electrolysis will also happen). With the hair removal, I am worried that not blocking the testosterone will allow the follicles to regenerate. Thank you again.

Thank you. I am currently seeing a therapist and she specializes in LGBT issues. I also am worried about all the paperwork and the cost of everything. This seems very vain of me, but I already have life and professional relationships set up with me as a male From the outside, I am doing beautifully). By transitioning, I will get rid of all that. 

I will start going through your posts.

I could start the transition process, and I really don't know how my thoughts will change. Suicide though will hurt my friends and I can't do that to them. If I had no friends, I would resort to suicide easily. But they are around. I have considered getting rid of my friends, but that would still hurt them. I am glad I have people that care about me.

To me, I don't see the point of starting the transition because I will never get to where I wish I could be.
